paragraphs.text:
You’re at point-blank range. Make a Firearms roll. If you hit 
and inflict 6 or more damage, he collapses unconscious and the 
other Brown Shirts flee (see end of entry). If you miss or don’t 
cause this much damage, the man launches at you with his knife 
(50%(25/10) attack, 1D6 damage). 
If he misses you, you can run away. Otherwise, as your next 
action, make a Dodge roll to escape. If you fail the Dodge roll, 
the man attacks again—you can Dodge or fight back; if you’ve 
caused a total of 6 or more damage he collapses and the Brown 
Shirts flee (see end of entry). Once his attack is resolved, you 
then have one more chance to make a Dodge roll to escape; if 
you fail this roll the Brown Shirts have you. You see another 
knife glint in the air, and then, it is … THE END.
However, if you’ve incapacitated the man and the Brown Shirts 
have fled, you can examine the contents of the attaché case, go 
to 470.
(484)
